label: InterPro
describes: Protein families, domains, sites, GO annotations (incl. InterPro-N deep-learning extension). 16 source DBs combined: pfam, cathgene3d, ssf, panther, cdd, profile, smart, ncbifam, prosite, prints, hamap, pirsf, sfld, antifam.

label: UniProt
describes: Protein sequence + functional + cross-reference resource. UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot (manually curated) + TrEMBL (auto-annotated). Resolves gene names → accessions and pulls full annotation graphs.

label: UCSC Genome Browser
describes: Genome conservation tracks (phyloP, phastCons), chain alignments, TFBS, multi-species comparisons. Use for the cross_species_atlas coordinate-only context. Adapter not yet shipped.

label: UniBind
describes: Curated transcription factor binding profiles across species (incl. teleost fish). Useful for evolution_atlas selection-scan context. Adapter not yet shipped.

label: STRING-DB
describes: Protein-protein interaction networks, functional association scores. Useful for evolution_atlas + inversion_atlas (interpreting candidate gene neighborhoods). Adapter not yet shipped.

label: Reactome
describes: Curated pathway membership (cell signaling, metabolism, DNA repair). Useful for enrichment of inversion candidate gene lists. Adapter not yet shipped.

label: QuickGO
describes: Gene Ontology annotations + term browsing. Wraps the same EBI infrastructure as InterPro. Adapter not yet shipped.

label: PubMed (NCBI E-utils)
describes: Literature lookup by DOI / PMID / search. Useful to populate references.jsonl entries and to validate manuscript chunk citations live against PubMed. NCBI E-utils 3 req/sec without API key, 10 req/sec with one. Adapter not yet shipped.
